It’s made from regenerative organic certified oils, is vegan, fair trade, EWG Verified, and free of detergents or foaming agents. It can be diluted for various uses like body, face, shaving, pet washing, and even cleaning, giving you more product per use due to its concentration. Plus, it has a seasonal cherry blossom scent and supports social causes.

The more affordable Almond - Pure-Castile Magic Bar Soap (5 oz) is also made with similar high-quality organic ingredients and certifications. It has a warm, nutty almond scent and is ready to use directly for body, face, and hair washing. Its smaller size and bar format might be preferable if you want something straightforward and convenient.
